title: Customer Help Desk: LR Tracking, Branches & Support | Vidhi
description: Use the Vidhi Transport Help Desk for live LR tracking, branch contacts, pickup requests, freight inquiries, service complaints and dispatch guidance.

hero.title: The right help, without searching the whole website.
hero.subtitle: Keep the shipment reference ready.
intro: Track a shipment, contact a branch, prepare a pickup, send an inquiry or register a service issue from one clear support page.
The operations team can respond more effectively when your request identifies the actual movement.
list: LR number for an existing consignment
Origin, destination and cargo for a new request

sections.title: Customer tools and support resources
intro: These are separate paths because a live shipment, new quotation, branch question and service complaint need different information. Choose the closest match and include accurate shipment details.

cards.title: Track an LR
body: Enter the receipt number to view the route, booking date, ERP status update and estimated delivery returned by the tracking service.

cards.title: Find a branch
body: View direct branch contacts, exact addresses, capabilities and nearby industrial service areas across Gujarat and Maharashtra.

cards.title: Request pickup
body: Prepare origin, destination, cargo, packaging, weight, date and handling details for an operations review.

cards.title: Send an inquiry
body: Use our inquiry form for a freight question, lane request, commercial query or general service support.

cards.title: Register a complaint
body: Report damage, non-delivery, document, POD, charge, delivery-mode or other consignment issues with the LR reference.

cards.title: GST & E-way Bill
body: Review a practical pre-dispatch documentation checklist and continue to official government resources for current requirements.

sections.title: Start with what you already have.
sections.subtitle: Speak to customer care.
intro: For urgent operational clarification, call during the published customer-care hours. Keep the LR number or complete shipment brief ready.
list: You have an LR number Use live tracking first, then contact customer care if the result needs clarification.
You have a new shipment Use pickup or inquiry and provide the precise route, cargo, packages, weight and date.
You have a service issue Use the complaint form so the LR, issue type and response contact stay together.

faqs.q: How can I check the status of a Vidhi Transport consignment?
faqs.a: Open Track LR and enter the numeric LR number from the transport receipt. If the live ERP service is unavailable, keep the LR number ready and contact customer care.

faqs.q: Where can I find a direct branch phone number?
faqs.a: The branch locator lists addresses, direct phone numbers, capabilities and nearby service areas for 14 locations across Gujarat and Maharashtra.

faqs.q: How do I register a service complaint?
faqs.a: Use the service complaint form and provide the LR number, issue type, description, route and an authorised contact. Complete information helps the team identify and investigate the consignment.

faqs.q: Can the Help Desk confirm a freight rate or vehicle?
faqs.a: No. Use the freight inquiry or quotation form to submit the actual cargo and route. Price, vehicle placement, schedule and cargo acceptance require separate operating confirmation.
